blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu City Sports Commission (CCSC) and the Association of Boxing Alliances in the Philippines (ABAP) Region 7 staged the inaugural “Battle at Fort San Pedro” amateur boxing event on Saturday, October 4, at the historic fort in Plaza Independencia, Cebu City. The unique boxing showcase pitted young amateur boxers from Cebu City against their counterparts from Mandaue City. The CCSC under chairman Dr. Rhoel Dejano organized the fight card in collaboration with ABAP Region 7 Director and CCSC Commissioner Lorenzo “Chao” Sy, under the sports initiative of Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival.
